detect: ^(Reading package lists\.\.\.|Building dependency tree|\d+ upgraded, \d+ newly installed|(Inst|Conf|Remv) \S+)
parser:
import re

ACT = re.compile(r'^(?P<action>Inst|Conf|Remv|Purg)\s+(?P<package>\S+)(?:\s+\[(?P<old>[^\]]*)\])?(?:\s+\((?P<version>\S+)(?:\s+(?P<source>.*?))?\s*\[(?P<arch>[^\]]+)\]\))?\s*$')
SUM = re.compile(r'^(?P<upgraded>\d+) upgraded, (?P<installed>\d+) newly installed, (?P<remove>\d+) to remove and (?P<not_upgraded>\d+) not upgraded\.?$')

def parse(lines):
    skip = []
    secrows = []
    seclines = []
    summ = {}
    sumlines = []
    acts = []
    actlines = []
    msgs = []
    msglines = []
    sec = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if l[:1] in (' ', '\t') and sec is not None:
            for p in s.split():
                secrows.append({'section': sec, 'package': p})
            seclines.append(i)
            continue
        sec = None
        m = SUM.match(s)
        if m:
            summ['upgraded'] = int(m.group('upgraded'))
            summ['newly installed'] = int(m.group('installed'))
            summ['to remove'] = int(m.group('remove'))
            summ['not upgraded'] = int(m.group('not_upgraded'))
            sumlines.append(i)
            continue
        m = ACT.match(s)
        if m:
            acts.append({'action': m.group('action'), 'package': m.group('package'), 'old version': m.group('old') or '', 'version': m.group('version') or '', 'source': (m.group('source') or '').strip(), 'arch': m.group('arch') or ''})
            actlines.append(i)
            continue
        if s.endswith(':'):
            sec = s[:-1]
            seclines.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^(Reading package lists|Building dependency tree|Reading state information)', s):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        msgs.append({'message': s})
        msglines.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if secrows:
        blocks.append({'name': 'package_lists', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': seclines, 'records': secrows})
    if summ:
        blocks.append({'name': 'summary', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': sumlines, 'records': [summ]})
    if acts:
        blocks.append({'name': 'actions', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': actlines, 'records': acts})
    if msgs:
        blocks.append({'name': 'messages', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': msglines, 'records': msgs})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
